slides.heading: AMT, CVT, DCT or torque converter: which automatic?

items: City comfort: CVT or torque converter
Highway fun: DCT, drive it smoothly in traffic

viz.label: test drive it there
viz.sub: Not just on an empty road

voice_lines: An AMT is the cheapest and gives good mileage, but shifts can feel jerky. A CVT is very smooth in the city, with a rubber band feel when you push it.
A DCT shifts fastest and is efficient, but doesn't like slow crawling. A torque converter is smooth and tough, and slightly thirstier.
Tight budget, AMT. City comfort, CVT or torque converter. Highway fun, DCT, driven smoothly in traffic.
Whichever you pick, test drive it in real traffic. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
Which automatic should you buy? 🚗

• AMT: cheapest, good mileage, shifts can feel jerky
• CVT: very smooth in the city, rubber-band feel when pushed
• DCT: fastest shifts, efficient, doesn't like slow crawling (be smooth in traffic)
• Torque converter: smooth and tough, slightly thirstier

Tight budget: AMT. City comfort: CVT or torque converter. Highway fun: DCT.

Whichever you pick, test drive it in real traffic. Which one do you drive? 👇

Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇
